title: Mitigating Dataset Harms Requires Stewardship: Lessons from 1000 Papers
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to evaluating the ethical harms of machine learning datasets throughout their lifecycle. It goes far beyond a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section by analyzing specific ethical concerns (privacy, bias, unethical applications) in depth, studying the effects of dataset retraction, and proposing a comprehensive ethical framework called 'dataset stewardship' with detailed recommendations for multiple stakeholders. The core thesis is an investigation into the moral and ethical dimensions of dataset creation, use, and management.
